Features.TOW-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create tow calls
Features.TAXI-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create taxi calls
Features.TRUCK_LOGS-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create truck logs.
Features.LICENSE_EXAMS-description: When enabled, this will require citizens to pass a license exam before they can obtain a license.
Features.AOP-description: When disabled, this will hide the AOP from the CAD.
Features.BUSINESS-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create and join businesses.
Features.ALLOW_DUPLICATE_CITIZEN_NAMES-descriptio: When enabled, this will allow users to create citizens with the same name (name and surname)
Features.BLEETER-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create bleets.
Features.COURTHOUSE-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to create expungement requests, name change requests. Users with the required permissions can create court entries and posts.
Features.WEAPON_REGISTRATION-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to register weapons.
Features.CALLS_911-description: When enabled, this will allow the user of 911 calls in the CAD.
Features.SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBERS-description: When enabled, this will allow citizens to use Social Security Numbers.
Features.CUSTOM_TEXTFIELD_VALUES-description: When enabled, this will allow users to enter custom vehicle/weapon values when registering a vehicle/weapon
Features.ACTIVE_DISPATCHERS-description: When enabled, certain buttons on the LEO and EMS/FD dashboard will become disabled when there is an active dispatcher.
Features.ALLOW_CITIZEN_UPDATE_LICENSE: Allow citizens to update their licenses
Features.ALLOW_CITIZEN_UPDATE_LICENSE-description: When disabled, this will only allow officers to manage licenses for citizens.
Features.ALLOW_REGULAR_LOGIN-description: When disabled, this will only allow users to login with Discord/Steam.
Features.ACTIVE_INCIDENTS-description: When enabled, this will allow Dispatch to create active incidents.
Features.RADIO_CHANNEL_MANAGEMENT-description: When enabled, This will allow dispatch to manage the radio channel a unit is in. This can then be used to enhance the experience via the CAD's Public API.
Features.ALLOW_CITIZEN_DELETION_BY_NON_ADMIN: Allow citizens to delete their own citizen
Features.ALLOW_CITIZEN_DELETION_BY_NON_ADMIN-desc: When enabled, this will allow citizens to delete their own citizen.
Features.DMV-description: When enabled, vehicles must first be approved by the Department of Motor Vehicles within the CAD.
Features.BADGE_NUMBERS-description: When enabled, this will allow officers to use badge numbers.
Features.USER_API_TOKENS-description: When enabled, this will allow users to generate their own API token to perform actions with via their account.
Features.CITIZEN_RECORD_APPROVAL-description: When enabled, this will require supervisors to accept or decline arrest reports before they can be used.
Features.COMMON_CITIZEN_CARDS-description: When enabled, this will allow any officers to edit, register vehicles/weapons to, create medical records to any citizen.
Features.CREATE_USER_CITIZEN_LEO-description: When enabled, this will allow officers to create citizens and vehicles that don't exist yet when searching for them. This citizen/vehicle will not be connected to any user.
Features.LEO_TICKETS-description: When enabled, this will allow officers to create tickets.
Features.LEO_BAIL-description: When enabled, this will allow officers to add bails to arrest reports.
Features.COURTHOUSE_POSTS-description: When enabled, this will allow users with the correct permissions to create posts in the courthouse. These posts will be visible to anyone.
Features.ACTIVE_WARRANTS-description: When enabled, this will display active warrants on the LEO Dashboard.
Features.WARRANT_STATUS_APPROVAL-description: When enabled, this will require supervisors to approve 'active' warrants.
Features.CITIZEN_DELETE_ON_DEAD: Delete citizen when marked as dead
Features.CITIZEN_DELETE_ON_DEAD-description: When enabled, this will delete the citizen when the citizen is marked as dead.
Features.PANIC_BUTTON-description: When enabled, this will allow LEO and EMS-FD to press a panic button.
Features.DIVISIONS-description: When enabled, this will require officers and EMS-FD deputies to provide their division(s).
Features.TONES-description: When enabled, this will allow Dispatch to create temporary messages for LEO and EMS/FD.
Features.CITIZEN_CREATION_RECORDS-description: When enabled, this allow citizens to add charges and flags to their citizen.
Features.BUREAU_OF_FIREARMS-description: When enabled, weapons must first be approved by the Bureau of Firearms within the CAD.
Features.CALL_911_APPROVAL-description: When a citizen creates a 911 call and there are active dispatchers, this will require dispatch to approve the call before active units can view the call.
Features.DISCORD_AUTH-description: When enabled, this will allow users to authenticate with Discord.
Features.STEAM_OAUTH-description: When enabled, this will allow users to authenticate with Steam.
Features.FORCE_DISCORD_AUTH-description: When enabled, this will force users to sync with Discord after registration.
Features.FORCE_STEAM_AUTH-description: When enabled, this will force users to sync with Steam after registration.
Features.MODERN_CITIZEN_THEME-description: When enabled, the citizen page uses the new card dashboard design. Disable it to use the default SnailyCAD design.
Features.API_TOKEN_REMINDER-description: When enabled, users who have not set up their personal API token (used for in-game integrations such as the FiveM script) will see a dismissible reminder banner at the top of the CAD.
Features.UNIT_PRIVATE_MESSAGES-description: When enabled, on-duty officers and EMS-FD deputies can send each other private messages from their dashboard. Only the two units can read them.
Features.RADIO-description: When enabled, dispatchers, units and FiveM players can talk on push-to-talk radio channels: in the browser (Dispatch, LEO, EMS-FD and the Radio page) and in game with the SnailyCAD Radio resource. Set up channels in CAD Settings > Radio.
Features.featuresIntro: Turn parts of the CAD on or off. Pick a category or search to find a feature, then save when you are done.
Features.unsavedChanges: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

CustomLocales.customLocalesDescription: An overview of the languages available in this CAD. This page is read-only: adding a locale requires access to the server files and a rebuild of the client.
CustomLocales.howToAdd: How to add a custom locale
CustomLocales.step1: Pick a valid locale code (ISO 639-1, optionally with a region, e.g. "es" or "es-ES").
CustomLocales.step2: Copy the en folder in apps/client/locales and rename the copy to your locale code:
CustomLocales.step3: Translate the .json files in the new folder. Only edit the values, never the keys, and do not edit the original en folder.
CustomLocales.step4: Register the locale in apps/client/i18n.config.mjs by adding it to the locales array (optionally make it the defaultLocale):
CustomLocales.step5: Rebuild the client so Next.js picks up the new locale:
CustomLocales.step6: Restart SnailyCAD. Users can now select the locale in their account settings.
CustomLocales.note: Tip: keep a copy of your custom locale outside the repository, updates may add new keys to the en files that you will need to translate as well. Missing keys are shown as their key name.
CustomLocales.customLocalesIntro: Add or manage the languages people can pick in their account settings. Everything happens here, no server access needed.
CustomLocales.addLanguageDescription: Starts from a copy of an existing language, which you can then translate.
CustomLocales.languageCodeExample: Use a language code like es, es-ES or pl.
CustomLocales.invalidCode: Use a code like es or es-ES.
CustomLocales.confirmRemove: Remove the language {code}? Its translation files are deleted.
CustomLocales.confirmRebuild: Apply the language changes now? The CAD is rebuilt and will be unavailable for a few minutes while a progress page is shown.
CustomLocales.rebuildNeededTitle: Language changes are waiting to be applied
CustomLocales.rebuildNeededMessage: New, removed or default languages take effect after the CAD is rebuilt (a few minutes).
CustomLocales.rebuildStartedMessage: The CAD is restarting with your changes. A progress page is shown until it is back, then it reloads automatically.
CustomLocales.rebuildManuallyMessage: This server can't restart the CAD by itself (for example on Windows or in Docker). Stop SnailyCAD, then run these commands in the SnailyCAD folder:
CustomLocales.dockerReadOnlyTitle: Languages are managed on the host
CustomLocales.dockerReadOnlyMessage: This CAD runs in Docker, so languages can't be changed from here. On the host, add or edit the language folder in apps/client/locales and its code in apps/client/i18n.config.mjs, then rebuild the images:
CustomLocales.languageAddedMessage: {code} was added. Apply the changes to make it available.
CustomLocales.translateHint: Translations live in the language files on the server. Missing translations show their English text once you fill missing files.

ImportPostgres.title: Import from PostgreSQL
ImportPostgres.intro: Bring the data of a PostgreSQL SnailyCAD into this MySQL / MariaDB CAD. The PostgreSQL database is only read, so the old CAD keeps working.
ImportPostgres.ownerOnlyMessage: Ask the owner of this CAD to import data from PostgreSQL.
ImportPostgres.sourceEnv: The old CAD's .env file on this server
ImportPostgres.envPathDescription: The full path, for example /home/user/snaily-cadv4/.env. Only its database settings and encryption token are used.
ImportPostgres.modeValuesDescription: Departments, statuses, call types, penal codes, vehicles, weapons, addresses and other values. Your accounts and settings stay as they are. This CAD must not have values yet.
ImportPostgres.modeReplaceDescription: All users, citizens, records, calls, settings and values. Everything in this CAD is replaced, including your account: afterwards you sign in with the old CAD's accounts.
ImportPostgres.usersFound: {count, plural, one {# user} other {# users}} in the old CAD
ImportPostgres.rowsToCopy: {rows} rows from {tables} tables will be copied
ImportPostgres.encryptionToken_matches: The encryption key matches the old CAD.
ImportPostgres.encryptionToken_different: The old CAD uses a different encryption key.
ImportPostgres.encryptionToken_unknown: The old CAD's encryption key is unknown (use its .env file to check it). Encrypted data such as API tokens and two-step codes may not work afterwards.
ImportPostgres.copyEncryptionToken: Use the old CAD's encryption key (needed for API tokens and two-step codes; the CAD restarts)
ImportPostgres.duplicateUsernamesTitle: Usernames that differ only in upper/lower case
ImportPostgres.duplicateUsernamesMessage: MySQL and MariaDB treat these as the same name. Rename one of each pair in the old CAD, then check again:
ImportPostgres.valuesNotEmptyMessage: It has {count} values, so they can't be imported without mixing them. Import everything instead, or start from a new CAD.
ImportPostgres.replaceWarningTitle: This replaces everything in this CAD
ImportPostgres.replaceWarningMessage: All current users, citizens, records and settings of this CAD are deleted and replaced by the old CAD's. If anything goes wrong, nothing is changed.
ImportPostgres.valuesDone: The values are ready to use. Reload the page to see them in the CAD.
ImportPostgres.restarting: The CAD restarts to use the old encryption key. This can take a few minutes.
ImportPostgres.replacedMessage: This CAD now has the old CAD's data and accounts, so you've been signed out. Sign in with your account from the old CAD.
ImportPostgres.error_psqlNotInstalled: psql isn't installed on this server. Install the PostgreSQL client (Ubuntu: sudo apt install postgresql-client).
ImportPostgres.error_envPathMustBeAbsoluteDotEnv: Enter the full path to a file called .env.
ImportPostgres.error_envFileNotFound: That .env file doesn't exist on this server.
ImportPostgres.error_envFileHasNoPostgresDatabase: That .env file has no PostgreSQL database settings.
ImportPostgres.error_databaseUrlNotMysql: This CAD's DATABASE_URL isn't a mysql:// URL.
ImportPostgres.error_migrateScriptMissing: scripts/mysql/migrate-data.mjs is missing from this CAD.
